analysis.purpose: The test suite for RustExtractor — it defines the behaviour that is guaranteed, so a change that breaks any of it fails the build. It pins: RustExtractor — golden (Rust symbol graph); RustExtractor — degradation + id-stability + lexer traps (gate); RustExtractor — Track 3 statement/condition/CFG edges; RustExtractor — extract_rules e2e (extractor → soul → decisionTable).
responsibilities: Pin the observable behaviour of RustExtractor
Fail the build when a guaranteed behaviour changes
